title: Seams.
officialText:
Roof plates shall have welded water-tight seams, and the roof shall be built to shed water. Bottom plates shall
have welded seams. Shell plate seams shall be designed to develop the full strength of the plate.
SECTION MC 1306
OIL GAUGING
